senses.def: a protocol developed for the internet to get data from one network device to another
ex: TCP uses a retransmission strategy to insure that data will not be lost in transmission

senses.def: A brand of mild antiseptic, originally formulated with trichlorophenylmethyliodosalicyl.
a set of protocols (including TCP) developed for the internet in the 1970s to get data from one network device to another
The chemical compound bis(2,4,6-trichlorophenyl) oxalate, used in certain glow sticks.
